profile.headline: Software Engineer at Synoptic Data PBC
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

company.name: Synoptic Data, a Public Benefit Corporation

positions.title: Research Scientist
positions.description:
- Works with the FAA’s Aviation Weather Division to create hourly and daily weather translated impact scores for forecasting and post-operation analysis for all centers and core airports within the entire National Airspace System (NAS), area and sectors within the NAS, and for specific regions
- Provides analyses on translated weather impact scores for verification, forecast quality, and accuracy purposes
- Analyzes text-based aviation weather products provided by the National Weather Service
- Analyzes text-based aviation advisories issued by the FAA
- Creates verification statistics on forecasted weather products for aviation customers around the world
- Provides trend detection analyses on forecasted weather products 
- Revamped company website to be more modern and user friendly
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · Python (Programming Language) · Data Visualization · Data Science · MongoDB · Databases · Statistical Data Analysis · Meteorology · Aviation · Problem Solving

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
- Developed the Multi-Year Reanalysis for Remotely Sensed Storms (MYRORSS) workflow for data processing, analysis, and visualization on the University of Oklahoma’s supercomputer
- Managed the MYRORSS dataset and public access to 80+ TB of data
- Supervised undergraduate assistants working on MYRORSS research projects including NWS warning characteristics, hail swath characteristics, and hail/tornado probability prediction using machine learning
- Developed machine learning algorithms using deep learning, neural networks, and random forests to predict hail size using Kara’s (Tensorflow backend) with radar reflectivity vertical profiles derived from single and multi-radars with the SHAVE dataset
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Data Analysis · Management · Machine Learning · Analytical Skills · Radar · Weather Radar · Meteorology

company.name: Cooperative Institute for Severe and High-Impact Weather Research & Operations

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Examining climate extremes of the Upper Missouri River Basin
- Data analysis of flux data from field sites and deployment of flux stations
- Flux Course Participant: a two week course in Nederland, CO learning about flux measurements at the leaf level; modeling leaf CO2 and H2O fluxes; eddy covariance measurements, synthesis using flux networks, prediction of fluxes from satellite observations; canopy flux models and assimilation of flux observations and satellite data into ecosystem process models
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · MATLAB · Statistical Modeling · Research Skills

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Validation of Water Vapor Sensing System on commercial aircraft using NWS radiosondes
- Data analysis, manipulation, and visualization of large datasets using MATLAB
- Fieldwork experience on Plains Elevated Convection at Night (PECAN)
positions.insights: Skills: MATLAB · Research Skills · Problem Solving · Data Visualization · Statistical Data Analysis · Aviation · Meteorology

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Multi-Year Reanalysis of Remotely-Sensed Storms (MYRORSS)
- Processing of WSR-88D data using WDSS-II
- Correcting/reprocessing radar data which was then used to develop multiple radar-based climatologies
Severe Hazards Analysis and Verification Experiment (SHAVE)
- Collected hail and wind data from the public
- Communicated reports to local weather forecast offices via NWS chat
- Collected data used for tornado damage survey
- Storm Tracking and Lightning Jump Analysis 
Hazardous Weather Testbed Experimental Warning Program
- Gathered storm reports and assisted forecasters in a simulated NWS weather forecast office
positions.insights: Skills: Data Processing · Data Quality Control · Data Collection · Linux

company.name: Cooperative Institute for Severe and High-Impact Weather Research & Operations

volunteerExperiences.description:
-Serves as an ambassador on a weekly basis at the Salt Lake City Lifesaving Center which involves greeting people, handling meet and greets with pets, and processing adoptions. 
- Trained on cat and dog care including handling, cleaning of pet spaces, and contagion control.
- Highlight a pet available for adoption during the ‘Pet of the Week’ segments (April 2023 - present).
- Handle scheduling and confirming all ‘Pet of the Week’ reoccurring segments for the Salt Lake City Lifesaving Center (April 2023 - present)
- Volunteer Recruitment Assistant : assisted with recruitment efforts for volunteers for the Best Friends National Conference including emailing potential contacts, posting flyers around town, and posting on social networking sites (November 2025 - May 2026)
